universe.asset_object: fungible SPL Token or Token-2022 mint that is the non-quote side of a newly initialized Raydium CPMM pool

observation_window.start: first UTC midnight after future host execution authorization

membership_evidence.purpose: CENSUS_UNIVERSE_ELIGIBILITY_TRUTH only; it is not MARKET_STATE evidence
required_fields: finalized slot and full-block transaction index
outer and nested initialization instruction path
candidate mint is the single non-quote mint
membership_evidence.failure_behavior: a failure of the later MARKET_STATE operation never removes an otherwise qualifying census member

inclusion: finalized successful Initialize or InitializeWithPermission invokes the frozen CPMM program
distinct sorted mint pair has exactly one fixed-set quote mint and one non-quote mint
the first qualifying finalized CPMM initialization for the canonical mint identity is inside the window
exclusion: two quote mints, two non-quote mints, identical mints, or unsupported token owner
an earlier qualifying initialization exists before window_start

newly_active_history.pre_window_exclusion: any earlier qualifying initialization excludes the mint; later pools are duplicates
newly_active_history.missing_history: archive/pruning gap, unresolved page, null required membership primitive, or unavailable prior-history check yields NEWLY_ACTIVE_HISTORY_COMPLETE=NO and invalidates the packet
newly_active_history.completeness: all finalized frozen-program history through census_close must close at the genesis boundary before the denominator is valid

raydium_initialization_time_semantics.INITIALIZE_OPEN_TIME_ARGUMENT: u64 instruction argument decoded after the frozen discriminator
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.INITIALIZED_POOL_STATE_OPEN_TIME: the program may store Clock unix_timestamp + 1 when the argument is not later than that clock; this stored field is not reconstructed by a later mutable-state read
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.INITIALIZATION_CLOCK_UNIX_TIMESTAMP: the runtime Clock value used by the program, distinct from RPC blockTime
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.LATER_CURRENT_POOL_STATE: never read for eligibility, newly-active classification, market legibility, or audit population
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.eligibility_rule: membership uses the frozen initialization event and history rules; a required initialization primitive that cannot be reconstructed is UNAVAILABLE_OR_INVALID

timestamps.eligibility_knowledge_at: fetched_at of first complete finalized census evidence
timestamps.fetched_at: provider observation/knowledge time, distinct from source_event_at
timestamps.rule: later corrections append evidence and cannot rewrite a sealed timestamp or make a current snapshot historical

duplicates_aliases_migrations.dedupe: retain earliest by slot, transaction index, instruction path, and signature bytes; later pools are linked duplicates
duplicates_aliases_migrations.aliases: metadata aliases, symbols, names, logos, and provider IDs are ignored
duplicates_aliases_migrations.migration: a new mint address is a new asset

complete_chain_census.observation_range: all finalized program history from slot 0 through the last finalized slot at census_close; membership is restricted to the window and prior-history exclusion uses genesis through window_start
complete_chain_census.pagination: newest-to-oldest limit=1000 pages, each next page uses the prior last signature as before; until is not used to hide history
complete_chain_census.termination: empty page after a strictly older cursor or genesis boundary; repeated cursor, non-decreasing slot, unexplained gap, or ceiling before closure fails completeness
complete_chain_census.finalized_evidence_mapping: resolve every required signature and verify its containing block and transaction index; retain response hashes
complete_chain_census.prior_history_check: group all decoded qualifying events by canonical mint and retain only earliest-in-window mints
complete_chain_census.completeness_accounting: retain pages, cursors, signatures, slots, resolutions, candidate/exclusion/unavailable counts, gaps, retries, bytes, credits, and cost
complete_chain_census.fail_closed: archive/pruning, null required primitive, provider gap, rate limit, timeout, malformed response, or unresolved account evidence makes CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO; it never shrinks the denominator
complete_chain_census.resource_ceiling: a ceiling before termination proof yields PACKET_VALID=NO and SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO

providers.temporal_semantics: finalized raw transaction event; LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION is the first continuously connected observation, REPLAY_RECOVERY is never a successful latency observation, and provider-created timestamps are never host receipt time
providers.schema_version: Yellowstone/gRPC schema and deployed revision pinned before execution; current revision UNKNOWN_TO_BE_MEASURED
providers.rate_limits_pricing: plan limits and public paid reference are documented; exact filtered-stream delivery, credits, completeness, and cost are UNKNOWN_TO_BE_MEASURED

INFERRED: raw delivery can be decoded with the pinned Raydium decoder

providers.authentication: separately controlled QuickNode endpoint/API key required later
providers.temporal_semantics: finalized slot, transaction-array index, instruction path, and immutable initialization event fields; no later current PoolState read
providers.request_role_boundary: this operation establishes only membership_evidence; it does not establish MARKET_STATE and is not counted as a MARKET_STATE success
providers.rate_limits_pricing: plan/RPS/archive and credit terms are documented at plan level; exact census availability and cost are UNKNOWN_TO_BE_MEASURED

DOCUMENTED: finalized JSON-RPC methods and response fields
INFERRED: pinned raw RPC plus Raydium decoder can establish minimal event identity

providers.product_api_family: QuickNode Solana mainnet-beta JSON-RPC, a separately scheduled per-asset raw initialization-evidence operation using getTransaction/getBlock and required account/instruction evidence
providers.authentication: QuickNode endpoint/API key required later; no credential is present or read now
providers.pricing: public QuickNode free/paid plan references; no spend is authorized and exact selected-operation credits/cost are UNKNOWN_TO_BE_MEASURED
providers.terms_constraint: QuickNode API-credit, account-use, and permitted raw-evidence-retention terms must be confirmed before execution
providers.temporal_semantics: the claim is the frozen initialization-time state at the eligible event's finalized slot, not a current snapshot; requests are triggered when the minimal census row becomes eligible, with fetched_at recording knowledge time
providers.request_trigger: one independent market-state request sequence per eligible universe member, started within 30 seconds of eligibility_knowledge_at; later backfill is LATE and cannot become a valid contemporaneous observation
providers.fetched_at: host UTC knowledge timestamp captured at request/response handling; never substituted for source_event_at

exact_fields.pool_account: PoolState account bound by the initialization instruction
exact_fields.candidate_mint: canonical non-quote mint and its frozen token-program identity
exact_fields.quote_mint: one member of the fixed quote-mint set
exact_fields.vault_accounts: both vault accounts bound by the initialization instruction
exact_fields.positive_initialization_amounts: both decoded initialization amounts are strictly positive
exact_fields.initial_status: known zero-initialized PoolState status under the pinned Raydium source semantics
exact_fields.finalized_event_binding: signature, slot, block transaction index, discriminator, instruction path, and non-null blockTime

providers.validity: AVAILABLE only when this operation independently receives and validates every required field, joins to the correct eligible identity and initialization boundary, and hashes the raw response; census success cannot substitute for it
providers.missing_behavior: every non-AVAILABLE status remains attached to the eligible asset and remains in the coverage denominator
providers.pagination: no market pagination; at most eight bounded raw RPC calls per asset; no response is silently truncated
providers.rate_limits: QuickNode plan/RPS/archive/credit terms apply; exact operation availability and cost are UNKNOWN_TO_BE_MEASURED
providers.schema_version: standard Solana JSON-RPC response schema with encoding, commitment, maxSupportedTransactionVersion, pinned Raydium decoder commit, and harness parser identity bound before execution; deployed endpoint revision UNKNOWN_TO_BE_MEASURED
providers.shared_backend: shares QuickNode infrastructure with census and DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT; no provider independence claim is made for this role
prohibited: current price, volume, return, survival, attention, or outcome fields
reusing a census response or treating census completion as market-state success

DOCUMENTED: Raydium CPMM scope and instruction family
INFERRED: a separately scheduled raw request can reconstruct the frozen initialization-time field set

receipt_clock.start_binding: at qualification process start capture wall_start_utc and mono_start_ns in one synchronous section, with no await or blocking work between the two reads
receipt_clock.observation_binding: for each LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION at callback entry capture wall_received_utc and mono_received_ns synchronously, without await; retain the raw pair and sampled offset

clock_skew_tolerance.justification: 250 ms is below 0.21% of the 120-second latency gate and bounds receipt-clock error at a sub-second scale relevant to provider freshness

validity_rules: source_event_at is non-null and discovery_latency_seconds = wall_received_utc - source_event_at is finite and >= 0
negative latency is INVALID_CLOCK and is never clamped or counted
a wall/monotonic offset discontinuity above 0.25 seconds makes the affected interval INVALID_CLOCK

required_pairs: before each receipt batch when batching exists
after each receipt batch when batching exists
checkpoints.interval_rule: compare each checkpoint offset with the immediately preceding checkpoint; a change above 0.25 seconds invalidates all receipt observations in the affected interval and the interval is retained
checkpoints.transient_step_rule: a step that is visible in any checkpoint or observation pair is invalid; start/end-only comparison is never sufficient; a wholly unobserved sub-cadence step cannot be inferred from timestamps and does not become a valid successful latency
checkpoints.implementation_determinism: the validity decision is a pure function of the frozen timestamp pairs, source_event_at, tolerance, and checkpoint interval labels

receipt_clock.latency_population: only LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION with a valid clock and non-null chain event time may enter p95; replay, duplicate, late, timeout, unavailable, malformed, unsupported, and invalid-clock cases remain visible and do not enter the success numerator

first_buyer_semantics.qualifying_acquisition: successful single-hop Raydium CPMM SwapBaseInput or SwapBaseOutput transferring positive net candidate-mint amount from pool vault to one recipient token-account owner and positive quote amount into the paired pool vault
first_buyer_semantics.success: meta.err == null; missing explicit success is unavailable
first_buyer_semantics.wallet_identity: owner of recipient SPL Token/Token-2022 account, not token-account address, fee payer, pool authority, program, mint authority, or fee account
first_buyer_semantics.duplicates: aggregate same-owner transfer rows within one qualifying swap; later acquisitions do not change first buyer
first_buyer_semantics.ambiguous: multiple positive recipient owners, missing owner, missing required instruction path, or identity collision
first_buyer_semantics.unavailable: provider/chain failure, missing field, failed transaction, unsupported parser, or ambiguity

audit_population.definition: every distinct canonical asset in the closed complete universe snapshot with complete outcome-independent mint, pool, initial signature, slot, and vault identity fields

audit_sampling.snapshot: full universe ledger at window end + 30 minutes, canonical bytes and SHA-256 committed before first-buyer or audit result inspection
audit_sampling.selector: SHA256(seed + '|' + universe_digest + '|' + canonical_asset_identity), unsigned hexadecimal byte sort, first min(200,N)

denominators.logical_case_rule: one stable scheduled case ID; retries are attempts and duplicates do not add rows

market_state.numerator: count of eligible universe members with status AVAILABLE and every exact market-state field valid from the independent market-state operation
market_state.denominator: all eligible universe members in the closed complete census
market_state.statuses: UNAVAILABLE, MALFORMED, TIMEOUT, UNSUPPORTED, late, invalid, and request failure remain in denominator and are not numerator
market_state.zero: zero denominator is NOT_REPORTABLE and cannot pass

parse.numerator: complete valid expected schema and mandatory fields
parse.denominator: all scheduled logical cases for the role
parse.failure: invalid, malformed, timeout, unavailable, late, and unsupported fail parse; retries do not change denominator

schema.numerator: logical case with a non-duplicate payload violating frozen schema/mandatory fields
schema.denominator: all scheduled logical cases for the role
schema.failure: timeout without payload is parse failure but not schema violation; duplicate conflict is schema evidence

discovery_latency.numerator: finite non-negative event-to-host-receipt seconds from LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION with valid receipt clock
discovery_latency.failure: invalid-clock, replay, duplicate, late, missing, timeout, unavailable, or null blockTime remains visible and is not a successful latency observation; p95 index is ceil(0.95*N)-1

first_buyer_availability.numerator: unambiguous first-buyer answer satisfying frozen semantics
first_buyer_availability.failure: all unavailable, malformed, ambiguous, provider-failure, and chain-audit-failure states remain denominator

audit_agreement.numerator: selected Helius identity and order exactly match QuickNode-derived chain truth
audit_agreement.failure: unavailable, malformed, ambiguous, provider-failure, chain-audit-failure, and disagreement are not success; no replacement

denominators.zero_population: all zero denominators are NOT_REPORTABLE and cannot pass

source_role_independence.audit_rule: direct audit uses only separately controlled QuickNode raw chain evidence and pinned Raydium interpretation; never Helius output or a derived/re-exported first-buyer dataset
source_role_independence.shared_backend_rule: census, market-state, and direct audit may share QuickNode infrastructure; this is disclosed and no independence is claimed for market-state

execution_shape.market_state_trigger_ceiling: one scheduled sequence per eligible asset; at most eight raw RPC calls, two retries per retryable call, and 30 seconds from eligibility_knowledge_at to first request
execution_shape.raw_evidence: retain permitted request/response bytes or immutable reference, SHA-256, source identity, schema/parser identity, timestamps, attempts, result classification, and cost for at least 24 months
execution_shape.parser_identity: later harness commit, Node/npm, contract digest, schema revisions, and parser version bound before first request; post-request change creates a new packet
execution_shape.cost_accounting: record plan, fixed fee, credits, requests, retries, bytes, overages, and invoice/usage evidence per source
execution_shape.failure_preservation: never delete, hide, or denominator-edit failed, late, duplicate, unavailable, invalid, or selected cases
